Economy · India

US tariff threat on Russian oil imports impacts India and Brazil

The US has proposed a 100% tariff on countries importing Russian oil, a move that could significantly affect India's energy imports. This action follows a previous US tariff imposition on Brazil, which is facing elections. The potential tariffs on India have drawn responses from political parties, while Brazil's government has indicated a measured response.
